title: ArchPilot: A Proxy-Guided Multi-Agent Approach for Machine Learning Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2511.03985v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent LLM-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in automated ML engineering. However, they heavily rely on repeated full training runs to evaluate candidate solutions, resulting in significant computational overhead, limited scalability to large search spaces, and slow iteration cycles. To address these challenges, we introduce ArchPilot, a multi-agent system that integrates architecture generation, proxy-based evaluation, and adaptive search into a unified framework. ArchPilot consists of three specialized agents: an orchestration agent that coordinates the search process using a Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS)-inspired novel algorithm with a restart mechanism and manages memory of previous candidates; a generation agent that iteratively generates, improves, and debugs candidate architectures; and an evaluation agent that executes proxy training runs, generates and optimizes proxy functions, and aggregates the proxy sco

translated_title: ArchPilot：一种用于机器学习工程的代理引导多智能体方法
translated_abstract: 近年来，基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体在自动化机器学习工程领域展现出了强大的能力。然而，它们严重依赖重复的完整训练运行来评估候选解决方案，导致显著的计算开销、对大型搜索空间的可扩展性受限以及缓慢的迭代周期。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了ArchPilot，一个将架构生成、基于代理的评估和自适应搜索整合到统一框架中的多智能体系统。ArchPilot由三个专门的智能体组成：编排智能体，使用受蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）启发的新型算法（带有重启机制）来协调搜索过程，并管理先前候选方案的存储记忆；生成智能体，迭代地生成、改进和调试候选架构；以及评估智能体，执行代理训练运行、生成和优化代理函数，并汇总代理得分。
tldr: ArchPilot提出了一个由编排、生成和评估三个智能体组成的多智能体系统，通过MCTS启发式的自适应搜索与基于代理的轻量级评估代替重复完整训练，大幅降低了自动机器学习工程的计算开销并加速了迭代周期。
en_tdlr: ArchPilot introduces a multi-agent system with orchestration, generation, and evaluation agents that uses an MCTS-inspired adaptive search and proxy-based lightweight evaluation to replace repeated full training runs, significantly reducing computational overhead and accelerating iteration in automated ML engineering.
